_note: The SINGLE PEP-OWNED component/package policy: the one authority for which runtime package names belong to each logical component (plus optional capture-time expected-binary policy). It is consumed by ALL THREE stages so they cannot diverge: release capture resolves a component's entry here (utillities/pep_capture_io.py), and both invocation planning and per-run request validation share the SAME mapping (utillities/pep_request.py derives COMPONENT_PACKAGES from this file; utillities/pep_invocation_plan.py reuses that in-memory object, never a copy). Add or retire a component/package mapping HERE ONLY -- there is no separate hardcoded registry. The filename and schema (pep-capture-policy/1) are retained to avoid churn; the 'capture' in the name is historical -- the role is the shared component/package policy, not capture-only. Package order matters: the FIRST allowed_runtime_package_names entry is the canonical/active package; later entries are still-accepted predecessors. expected_binary_version is optional capture-time identity policy ("" = none). This file NEVER carries platform / OS / architecture / PostgreSQL policy -- that universe is owned by configuration/containers_list.json + utillities/pep_exec_catalog.json and is formed by intersecting built cells with PEP's execution catalog. 'pgedge-capture-smoke' is the internal synthetic fixture component used by the capture smoke and the coordinator live-validation caller.
